lead_independence.headline: Palm City woman held on $270,000 bond in neglect of 36 Border Collies found in home
lead_independence.lead: Paige O'Donnell faces 72 charges of animal cruelty after Martin County Sheriff's deputies found 36 Border Collies in deplorable conditions at her home.
